The paper proposes a retrieval/context-selection method for RAG systems and validates it with tests comparing it against simple strategies. It is text-only. Whether a generator conditions on the retrieved text in the experiments is unclear, since the validation seems to focus on retrieval quality. Even so, the method is explicitly designed as the retrieval layer of a RAG system, so a retrieval-focused evaluation is plausible grounds for inclusion. The rules say not to exclude just because the abstract is thin on experimental detail, and E1 only applies when it is clearly retrieval without a generator. This is borderline, but the abstract reports validation experiments and frames the work as RAG context construction, so I lean toward INCLUDE.
